name: Unnamed Brass
languages: understands Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak but can't speak

Traits.name: Resonant Sense
Traits.text: The brass pinpoints the exact location of any creature that has dealt Thunder damage to it or that stands on the ground within its tremorsense range, even through walls, and can perceive such creatures as though it could see them.
Traits.clause: The brass has no eyes or mouth but perceives by vibration and pressure, sensing the exact location of any creature that
Traits.expressedQuote: stands on the ground within its tremorsense range

Traits.name: Thunder Absorption
Traits.text: Whenever the brass is subjected to Thunder damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Thunder damage dealt.

Traits.name: Siege Monster
Traits.text: The brass deals double damage to objects and structures.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The brass makes two Sweeping Arm attacks.

Actions.name: Sweeping Arm
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 10 ft. 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Clanging Shock (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* 60 (11d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.

lore: Stamped in the workshops of a vanished artificer guild that named its creations but never gave them faces, this brass brute was built to clear and guard, outlived every command that once bound it, and now searches the ruins on its own for walls worth breaking.

generation.userConcept: a brass automaton with no mouth, no eyes and no name

clauses.text: a brass automaton with no mouth

generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)

immunities: Poison, Thunder; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a brass automaton with no mouth, no eyes and no name
